title: Trust Center
seo_description: How Labora protects patient data for diagnostic labs: role-based access, audit trails, signed report releases, secured cloud infrastructure, and our compliance program.

fields.hero_lead: Every action in Labora is attributed and recorded, access follows each person's role, and every report is released by an authorized doctor. Here is how we protect your lab's data, and what we are building next.
fields.overview_title: Security is part of the workflow, not an add-on
fields.overview_text: The controls are built into the screens your team already uses, from the front desk to the reporting doctor.

overview_cards.title: Every action has a name on it
overview_cards.text: Registrations, results, corrections, and signatures are recorded against a named user and a time, so every report can be traced from the front desk to the doctor.

overview_cards.title: Accountability at every step
overview_cards.text: Each step in the life of a sample leaves a record, and nothing is overwritten silently.

overview_cards.title: Access built around roles
overview_cards.text: Front desk, technicians, doctors, and accounts each see what their job needs. Your admins decide who gets which role.

overview_cards.title: Safeguards for patient results
overview_cards.text: Results reach patients and referring doctors only after review and sign-off, with every change explained.

fields.access_title: Everyone sees what their role needs
fields.access_text: Permissions follow each person's job, so the front desk can register patients without seeing results, and only authorized doctors can sign and release reports.
fields.access_checks:
Roles for front desk, technicians, doctors, accounts, and admins
Access configured per role and per center
Report release limited to authorized doctors
fields.access_note: Example configuration. Roles and permissions are set up to match how your lab works.
fields.audit_title: Know who touched every record, and when
fields.audit_text: Every registration, result, correction, signature, and delivery is recorded against a named user and a time, so you can answer any question about a report from one place.
fields.audit_checks:
User and time on every action
Earlier and new values kept for every correction
Signed releases you can trace back to the doctor

fields.disc_text: If you find a security issue in Labora, please tell us privately first so we can fix it before it affects any lab.

disc_steps.title: Report
disc_steps.text: Email {security_email} with what you found and how to reproduce it.

disc_steps.title: Acknowledge
disc_steps.text: We confirm receipt and keep you updated while we investigate.

disc_steps.title: Fix
disc_steps.text: We validate the issue, fix it, and verify the fix.

disc_steps.title: Close
disc_steps.text: We let you know when it is resolved and thank you for helping.

fields.disc_guidelines:
Only test accounts you own or have permission to use.
Never access, change, or keep patient data that is not yours. Stop and report as soon as you see any.
Do not run tests that could disrupt service, such as denial of service or heavy automated scanning.
Give us reasonable time to fix the issue before sharing it publicly.
fields.disc_contact_text: Include the steps to reproduce, the affected page or feature, and how to reach you.
fields.faq_text: Common questions from lab owners and IT teams.
fields.cta_text: Our team can walk your IT or compliance lead through how Labora handles access, audit trails, and patient data, and help with your security questionnaire.
